lines.en: I hang here, swaying with the wind.
I don't walk; the leaf sways.

lines.zh: 我把自己固定在叶柄上
lines.en: I've fixed myself to the leaf's stem.
In a strong gust I turn half a circle.

lines.zh: 这些日子我只做一件事
lines.en: All these days I do one thing only.
My casing is slowly hardening.
I haven't shifted a finger's width.
Rain hits; I rock twice.
What's inside me is rearranging.
Swaying is the only motion I have.

lines.zh: 叶子挪一点，我也挪一点
lines.en: The leaf shifts; I shift with it.
I hang quietly where I am.
The branch shadows have moved on.

lines.zh: 我把自己固定在叶柄上。
lines.en: I fixed myself to the leaf stalk.

lines.zh: 我的外壳透出一点颜色
lines.en: A hint of color shows through my case.
Nearly ready. A little more.
I hang below the leaf.
I do nothing all day.
A thin sheen lies on my case.
When the wind stops, the world goes still.

lines.zh: 我在里面慢慢动了一下
lines.en: Inside, I move a little.
Light comes through the case.
I listen to the sounds outside.
A bug crawls up beside me.
I ignore it; it doesn't touch me.
This leaf still holds.
My hour hasn't come.
Wait. Almost.
You lean in to look at my case.
You took me for a dead leaf.
I can't move. Don't touch.
Your hand is large. Don't squeeze.
I'm inside, and I can see you.

lines.zh: 你看我的翅芽，还没展开。
lines.en: You see my wing buds, still folded.
A few days more and I'll come out.
Keep watching. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 壳上那道裂是我的翅膀
lines.en: That seam on my case is my wing.
I'm no longer a caterpillar.
Something inside me has been startled.
The blow spun me all the way round.
Something inside has been disturbed.
I can't dodge. I can only endure.
The leaf has been pulled askew.
My case has grown thinner.
I keep as tight and still as I can.
That one was heavy.
I'm still here, still hanging.
Don't touch it again.
I can't eat anything now.
The leaf is right here, and I don't move.

lines.zh: 你把叶子贴过来也没用
lines.en: Pressing a leaf to me won't help.
At this stage I don't feed.
I only wait for time to pass.

lines.zh: 那味道我闻得到，但不想要
lines.en: I smell it, and don't want it.
A wetland chrysalis; don't move me.
My mouthparts have changed.
Ask me again after I'm out.
Don't touch my case with that.
The leaf rocks and I knock the underside.
I'm holding fast. I didn't fall.
You tap the leaf; I sway with it.
This case isn't very hard.
Don't press; it would split.
The bump turned me half around.
Your finger brushed my case.
I swing back under the leaf.

lines.zh: 这一点摇晃我还受得住
lines.en: This much rocking I can bear.
Don't push again.
In this state, there's nothing to speak of.
Are you waiting too?
When we're both out, then we'll see.
I can barely move at all.
You hang on the leaf beside mine.
A few leaves lie between us.
The wind swings us the same way.

lines.zh: 我不需要什么，只需要时间
lines.en: I need nothing but time.
When the time comes, wings will say it.
Don't rush. I won't either.

lines.zh: 湿地的水汽浸软了我的壳。
lines.en: Wetland damp has softened my shell.

lines.zh: 露珠从叶尖滑到我壳上。
lines.en: A dewdrop slides from the leaf tip onto my shell.

lines.zh: 我不需要拿，也不需要放
lines.en: I needn't take, and needn't put down.
None of this is any use to me.

lines.zh: 你放在叶子边，我看得见
lines.en: Set it by the leaf and I can see it.
Don't press it against my case.
It's too heavy; the leaf would fail.
I've no hand to reach out.

lines.zh: 等出去以后，那才有意义
lines.en: After I emerge, it would matter.
For now, put nothing there.
A shadow stops beside me.
I've no eyes to make it out.
I hear only a faint sound.
The leaf bends that way.
I keep still and let it pass.

lines.zh: 它在叶子上停了一会儿
lines.en: It paused on the leaf a while.
I'd rather it didn't notice me.
My case matches the leaf's color.
It's gone, and the leaf still sways.
I go on waiting.
That shadow stays nearby.
It circles the leaf.
I can only listen. I can't move.
It's come near the leaf's stem.
I draw myself in a little.
Something inside me races.
It's reaching out with something.

lines.zh: 那只鸟的爪子就在我上方。
lines.en: A bird's claws are right above me.
I can only wait for its decision.
The leaf sways once, then stills.
I can't even bump into anything.

lines.zh: 这层壳是我的全部防御
lines.en: This case is all the defense I have.
Even one touch hurts me.
All I can do is tighten up.
A small flake came off my case.
Swaying is my only reply.
It withdrew, and the leaf settled.
I'm still hanging where I was.
Something's still moving inside.
I'm still alive.
I formed this case on the leaf's underside.
The last of the silk is spun.
The outside world has grown small.
I can't see, but I can hear.
I've fixed myself here.
The leaf gives me what I need.
Only waiting remains.
The wind will keep rocking me.
Inside, I am growing anew.

lines.zh: 等我出来时，就完全不同了
lines.en: When I come out, I'll be wholly different.
The heat softens my case.

lines.zh: 我和叶子一起掉了下去
lines.en: The leaf and I fell together.
Water soaks through me; I feel stifled.
The blast tears me off the stem.
Something sharp pierced the case.
This force makes my case grow warm.
I stopped feeding long ago.
Thunder makes the leaves rattle.
The leaf is gone, and I fall with it.
